title: fuelcenter
description: Marathon fueling, pace, hydration, heat, carb-loading, and gel-comparison calculators.
summary: Marathon fueling, pace, hydration, heat, carb-loading, and gel-comparison calculators.
offersHint: Marathon fueling, pace, hydration, heat, carb-loading, and gel-comparison calculators. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://fuelcenter.co/api/mcp

toolsPreview.name: fueling-plan
toolsPreview.description: Build a minute-by-minute race or long-run fueling plan. Returns target carbs/hour, gel count, gel timing schedule, and total carbs. This is the core FuelCenter tool.

toolsPreview.name: race-time-predictor
toolsPreview.description: Predict your finish time at common distances (5K through 100 miles) from a recent race result using the Riegel formula.

toolsPreview.name: pace-calculator
toolsPreview.description: Given any two of distance, total time, or pace-per-mile, calculate the third. Returns pace per mile, per km, splits, and speed.

toolsPreview.name: heat-adjustment
toolsPreview.description: Estimate how temperature and humidity will slow your race pace and change your fluid needs. Returns adjusted pace, slowdown percent, dew point, risk level, and fueling note.

toolsPreview.name: hydration
toolsPreview.description: Estimate fluid and sodium needs for a race or long run based on body weight, duration, intensity, temperature, and humidity.

toolsPreview.name: carb-loading
toolsPreview.description: Calculate pre-race carb loading targets by race type, body weight, finish time, and experience level. Returns daily carb target, protocol length, total carbs, and pre-race meal size.

toolsPreview.name: gel-comparison
toolsPreview.description: Return the FuelCenter gel catalog (SiS Beta Fuel, Maurten, Precision, GU, Tailwind, Spring, Carbs Fuel, neversecond, Huma) with carbs, price, caffeine, weight, and carbs-per-dollar. Optionally sort.
